Transluce description (independent “ground truth”, exemplar-based)
score 0.35base64 encoded token 3 and related variations, including "проверять", "на", "str"
The neuron activates specifically on the base64 encoded token 3 and variations (e.g., C, T) encountered in user prompts. Additionally, the occurrence of tokens like "проверять", "на", and "str" within base64 context relating to encoded formats triggers activation.
score 0.58Base64 encoded text containing Z and its variations (tlZ, xl, dp, d)
appearances of the token Z and variations of it (e.g., tlZ, xl, dp, d) within the context of Base64 encoded text.
L2·N5802unmasked layer
The neuron's activation is driven by the ordinal suffix sub-token ("th"/"st") attached to a numeral: it activates positively when the ordinal is a day-of-month/date or list rank (14th year, 12th April, 31st May), and is strongly suppressed when the same "th" forms a century expression ("19th century").
